calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, status,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
       SUM(f.gross_amount) AS web_gross_sales_incl_vat,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS net, COUNT(*) AS n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS n_distinct_lines,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS orders
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = w.dispatch_date
WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
mine AS (
  SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_mine
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1
),
ctl AS (
  SELECT business_date, net_sales_before_returns AS net_ctl FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id = 900
)
SELECT d.fiscal_period, COUNT(*) AS days, SUM(COALESCE(net_mine,0)) AS mine, SUM(COALESCE(net_ctl,0)) AS ctl,
       SUM(COALESCE(net_mine,0)) - SUM(COALESCE(net_ctl,0)) AS diff,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(COALESCE(net_mine,0)-COALESCE(net_ctl,0))>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS days_differing
FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN mine m ON m.business_date = d.calendar_date LEFT JOIN ctl c ON c.business_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'dup_receipt_line' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS n FROM (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-06-01' AND DATE '2024-11-10' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_web_order', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_lines_nonstore900_WB', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.channel_code='WB' AND s.store_id<>900
UNION ALL
SELECT 'store900_lines_no_order', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND o.web_order_id IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'store900_lines_notdispatched_in_window', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND o.status NOT IN ('delivered','collected')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'zz_test_web_lines_in_window', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category='ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-06-01' AND DATE '2024-11-10'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ref_fiscal_not_fully_loaded', COUNT(*) FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6 AND NOT fully_loaded

calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
)
SELECT d.fiscal_period, f.vat_rate, COUNT(*) AS n,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(f.gross_amount - ROUND(f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate),2))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inconsistent,
       SUM(CASE WHEN f.gross_amount IS NULL OR f.net_amount IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nulls,
       SUM(f.gross_amount) AS gross
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=w.dispatch_date
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
